items.title: Dr Sanjay Nigam, Dr Nitu Nigam Parents of Ishaan Nigam - VIII
items.description: Education is the key to success in life, and teachers make a lasting impact in the lives of their students Enrolling my child in DPS Jankipuram was one of the best decisions I've made as a parent. The genuine care and attention they receive, including through the grooming program, have truly shaped them into a remarkable individual. As a parent, seeing the transformation in my child's confidence and self-assurance, thanks to DPS Jankipuram's grooming efforts, fills me with pride and gratitude. I'm thankful to DPS Jankipuram for not only focusing on academic excellence but also for nurturing my child's character through their grooming program. It's a testament to their commitment to comprehensive education. The grooming my child has received at DPS Jankipuram goes beyond just appearances; it's about instilling values of respect, self-care, and confidence. I couldn't be happier with their holistic approach to education. DPS Jankipuram isn't just a school; it's a community that fosters growth and development in every aspect. I've witnessed firsthand how their grooming program has helped my child blossom into a well-rounded individual.

items.title: Ms. Sanjana Mittal Mother of Nayan Mittal - Nur
items.description: This session at DPS proved to be a new milestone in my daughter Nayan's academic growth. My baby who had howled her eyes out on her first day in the preceding year, bid a laughter filled goodbye to me at the beginning of her second year at DPS in Nursery A. I too was confident that, her class teacher Ms. Rajshree Awasthi will take her under wings and nurture her. This was just the first day of what proved to be a blessed year ahead. She engaged in active classroom learning which reflected in her over enthusiastic communications at home. Her few online classes gave us a glimpse of how our chirpy bird became a dedicated pupil during the class hours. Her participation in plethora of extracurricular activities and stage performances showed that her holistic development was being ensured at the school. The highlights of the year were when we got to see our little ones speaking and performing very confidently and in a disciplined manner on the stage. I am very thankful to DPS for ensuring that our kids are being nurtured into beautiful people both in and out. I am especially thankful to Ms. Rajshree Awasthi for understanding the individual needs of each child. It is no wonder that Principal Ma'am leaves no stone unturned to make sure that the children are in the best of the hands.

items.title: Col. Chinmaya Varma, Dr. Rajul Varma Parents of Ishita Varma - IX, Ishaan Varma - VI
items.description: This is to put on record the gratitude and thanks towards the teachers and coordinator of your esteemed school, DPS Jankipuram. Being a transfer case from Delhi, I put both my daughter, Ishita Varma and son, Ishaan Varma in CI XI and VI respectively in the middle of the term when the session was already in full swing in the month of August. We were very concerned about our kids progress as they were new to the environment with all unknown faces. However, all my worries were put to rest after initial 15 days of their joining the school. They were welcomed wholeheartedly by the teachers and the staff who went an extra mile to make them comfortable and up to date with their curriculum. Both my kids have performed exceedingly well under their guidance and it speaks volumes about your teaching staff. A special mention for Saima Ma'am, Class Teacher of 6 E, who has been immensely supportive and guiding from day 1 of my son's joining and always been helpful and patient regarding all types of queries from my end. Sweet natured, a thorough professional and an able teacher to the kids. I would also like to thank Parnika Ma'am, coordinator of 6th grade for all the support throughout the session .All our best wishes to the esteemed school.

items.title: Ms Niharikha Srivastava Mother of Aarna Srivastava - P.G.-A
items.description: Initially I was bit sceptical about admitting my two-and-a-half-year daughter to playschool. We visited several schools but I became confident after visiting the junior wing of DPS Jankipuram. The facility is well equipped for the complete development of young minds and the teachers as well as the supporting staff is very loving and caring. They impart knowledge with playtime in a very homely environment. My daughter hardly took one weeks' time to become fond of her school. The back-to-back activities, writing work, celebrations, and visits keep the toddlers busy and active. I would like to specially thank Ms Monika ma'am for taking care of the kids in a very creative and affectionate way. My daughter is very fond of her. So, I am very happy about my decision of admitting my daughter to DPS Jankipuram.

items.title: Mother of Nishka Kapoor - VE, Navya Kapoor - IX
items.description: Delhi Public School has consistently impressed with its comprehensive array of facilities and educational resources, fostering an environment where students can truly thrive. The school's commitment to excellence is evident in its state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, and library that provide students with the tools they need to excel academically. Furthermore, the school's focus on holistic development is reflected in its extensive sports facilities, arts studios, and extracurricular programs, allowing students to explore and develop their talents beyond the classroom. With a dedicated faculty and staff who leverage these resources to create enriching learning experiences, Delhi Public School sets a high standard for educational excellence and remains a beacon of inspiration for students and educators alike.

items.title: Ms. Anupama Mother of Anudhya Srivastava - II
items.description: We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for the outstanding care and education that our child is receiving at your school especially Deeba mam the class teacher of my daughter. As parents, we are genuinely satisfied with the dedication and commitment demonstrated by both the school and its teachers. It is truly reassuring to witness the nurturing environment and the positive impact it has on our child's development. We commend your efforts and encourage you to continue the excellent work. Your commitment to fostering a conductive learning atmosphere is highly appreciated. Here's to the continued growth and success of  DPS.
